name: Compute Cluster S41: Where-Literal Frequency Trap
description: Tests: where(cond, 1.0) always returns 100% mean (WRONG for frequency), ternary 1.0 if cond else 0.0 for correct hit rate, Count vs Mean aggregation on sparse vs dense flags.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S41: Where-Literal Frequency Trap
# Tests: where(cond, 1.0) vs ternary for frequency/hit-rate
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
ret = returns(close)

# === SIGNAL ===
is_bullish = ret > 0

# === WRONG: where(cond, literal) for frequency ===
# Mean of where(is_bullish, 1.0) = mean([1.0, 1.0, ...]) = 100% always
bull_where = where(is_bullish, 1.0)

# === CORRECT: ternary for frequency ===
# Mean of [1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, ...] = actual hit rate
bull_ternary = 1.0 if is_bullish else 0.0

# === CORRECT USE OF WHERE: filtering a metric to event bars ===
bull_ret = where(is_bullish, ret)

# === REPORTERS ===
cards(
    category='Frequency Trap',
    layout=CardLayout(title='Where vs Ternary Comparison', cells=[
        ColumnSpec(title='where(cond, 1.0) Mean (WRONG)', card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='Ternary Mean (CORRECT)', card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='Bull Return Mean', card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=4)
    ])
)(bull_where, bull_ternary, bull_ret)

xy_lines(
    title='Ternary Bull Flag (correct frequency)',
    category='Frequency Trap',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Bull Flag', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=bull_ternary)
